description.value: Cora is a Canadian breakfast-and-lunch franchise chain known for colourful, fruit-laden plates, crêpes, waffles, and skillets. The Victoria location sits on Douglas Street in the downtown core, making it a convenient mid-ride fuel stop for cyclists passing through the city centre. The menu leans heavily toward morning fare served until mid-afternoon.
